With a team of over 9,500 employees, Hikma operates 29 manufacturing plants and 9 R&D centers across MENA, North America, and Europe, offering over 800 generic, specialty, and branded pharmaceutical products. Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team. Work Environment The Electrical Technician will work within a supportive environment that prioritizes employee wellbeing and encourages professional growth. The company fosters an inclusive culture where contributions from all team members are valued. Application Information This position is based in Riyadh. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

d5ad10a019a514ee.description: About the Role Alfanar is seeking a Senior Testing & Commissioning Engineer Medium Voltage to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves performing testing and commissioning activities for medium voltage equipment, ensuring adherence to quality standards, and resolving technical issues. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Conduct tests on relays and other equipment in accordance with project testing plans. Prepare and update project/new equipment test reports. Perform functional testing as outlined in scheme documents. Report nonconformances and troubleshoot technical issues. Clear and manage punch lists during factory testing and site commissioning. Coordinate testing activities during customer inspections. Provide technical support by reviewing design documents prior to release. Resolve technical issues encountered during factory testing and site commissioning. Execute site testing and commissioning activities. Leadership and Team Development Train subordinates and build effective teams. Provide leadership, coaching, and direction to subordinates. Delegate assignments and ensure fair distribution of tasks to maintain team morale. Operational Management and Quality Assurance Perform planned activities to meet operational and development targets according to delivery schedules. Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time parameters. Provide periodic reports detailing deviations and execution of planned tasks. Resolve operational problems and escalate complex issues as needed. Ensure adherence to quality requirements, developing effective quality control processes and specifications. Initiate continual improvement efforts and maintain records in consultation with the department manager. Initiate corrective and preventive actions and maintain associated records. Process Improvement and Compliance Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, and procedures. Seek automation opportunities for business processes. Comply with all related policies, procedures, and work instructions. Qualifications 5-10 years of experience in testing and commissioning, specifically with medium voltage equipment. Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot technical issues and manage quality assurance processes. Experience in leading and developing teams.

d523e8ca592cdce0.description: About the Role The Learning Support Teacher will support students with additional learning needs at British School Dhahran, enabling them to access the curriculum, participate fully in school life, and achieve progress from their individual starting points. This full-time position is based in Al Khobar or Dhahran, Eastern Region, and reports to the Head of Learning Support. Key Responsibilities Deliver targeted teaching and collaborate with classroom teachers, families, and specialists to identify learning barriers. Adapt provision and review the impact of support within BSD’s Multi-Tiered System of Supports (MTSS). Help students develop skills, confidence, and independence for success in their classes and beyond. Safeguarding and Professional Conduct Safeguard and promote student welfare, adhering to ISG's child protection procedures and reporting concerns promptly. Maintain professional boundaries and complete all required training. Handle sensitive information in line with school procedures, sharing it with relevant colleagues for student support or safeguarding. Participate in professional learning, act on feedback, and use evidence of student learning to improve practice. Contribute to school priorities and undertake other duties appropriate to the role. Assessment, Teaching, and Intervention Identify learning barriers through classroom observations, student work, assessment evidence, and input from students and families. Establish baseline performance, monitor student progress, and evaluate intervention effectiveness to inform instructional decisions. Plan and deliver targeted individual and small-group teaching, linking it to the classroom curriculum. Utilize evidence-informed approaches for literacy, numeracy, organization, and independent learning. Select appropriate resources and assistive technology to enhance access and participation. Develop and review individual support plans with clear, measurable goals, and maintain accurate records of assessment, provision, and progress. Inclusive Classroom Practice and Collaboration Strengthen inclusive classroom teaching and provide targeted support within the MTSS framework. Participate in Student Support Team (SST) problem-solving, contributing assessment evidence and intervention recommendations. Collaborate with classroom teachers on Universal Design for Learning (UDL), differentiation, and scaffolding for Tier 1 instruction. Assist teachers in anticipating barriers and planning practical adjustments to instruction, resources, routines, and assessment. Work with teaching assistants to clarify support delivery, fostering student independence. Contribute to student review meetings and support transitions between classes, year groups, and phases. Build constructive relationships with families, explaining student strengths, needs, and progress, and involving them in support decisions. Company Values The successful candidate will support مدارس المجموعة العالمية (ISG)'s mission, "We inspire innovation and compassionate action," and model its core values of Respect, Acceptance, Integrity, and Responsibility. This includes fostering relationships with students, families, and colleagues, and contributing to the ISG Graduate Profile by helping students recognize their strengths and take responsibility for their learning.

d53e7adcf25db9d2.description: About the Role King Faisal Specialist Hospital and Research Center in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, is seeking a Legal Advisor. This full-time role is essential for maintaining the Hospital's operational integrity within the legal and regulatory framework of the Kingdom. The Legal Advisor will provide expert legal counsel and manage all related legal cases, contributing directly to the stability and growth of the institution. Key Responsibilities Advise senior management on legal issues impacting the Organization. Develop and maintain the Organization's standard terms and conditions for all commercial contracts. Ensure legal terms and conditions of draft contracts comply with relevant Saudi laws and regulations. Prepare and formulate decisions and directives related to organizational activities, providing viewpoints on legislative tools. Organize legal opinions on significant regulatory and legal issues. Advise the Hospital, including employees, departments, executives, and the Board of Directors, on legal strategy for litigation or settlement of disputes. Monitor changes in local, regional, and international agreements and legislations, studying their impact on the organization. Advise senior management on all relevant regulations from government and other bodies. Provide counsel on issues pertinent to the implementation and application of ethical and legal principles for medical professionals, conducting appropriate investigations. Advise on legal aspects related to the Hospital’s policies and procedures. Offer guidance on international best practices for providing legal services. Render legal opinions on personnel matters as required, interpreting the Employee Relations Manual (ERM) and other legal provisions. Required Experience Candidates for this position should possess 5 to 10 years of relevant legal experience, demonstrating a strong understanding of legal frameworks and regulatory compliance within a complex organizational setting. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, at the King Faisal Specialist Hospital and Research Center. It is a full-time position requiring dedicated engagement within the Hospital's legal department. Compensation Salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process and is not disclosed at this time.

d5aaa6ebc51f6c39.description: About the Role Afaq - Logistics Branch is seeking a Senior Account Manager, Quick Commerce, Last Mile Logistics, Delivery Service Partners (Saudi National) to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves advising and partnering with Amazon’s Delivery Service Partners (DSPs), who operate last-mile delivery businesses for Amazon. The Senior Account Manager will lead a team of 6+ managers, overseeing more than 80 delivery partners within Amazon’s quick commerce business, which includes 15-minute and 2-hour delivery services across Saudi Arabia. Role Context and Responsibilities The Senior Account Manager will manage partner relationships throughout the business lifecycle, addressing challenges, shaping business plans, and identifying obstacles to support effective decision-making and success. This position requires regular travel to meet business owners in person weekly. The role involves working with a diverse group of entrepreneurs, ranging from those new to logistics to seasoned carriers. Lead a team of 6+ account managers and their portfolio of 80+ delivery partners, focusing on strategy, accountability, and key performance metrics. Collaborate with internal teams, including Program Managers, Compliance, and Finance personnel, to ensure partners launch and scale in adherence to program requirements. Support owners by removing operational obstacles and enhancing financial, operational, and safety practices at the network level. Analyze problems, generate insights, provide recommendations, and drive change internally and externally as a Lead, Logistics Supply Chain Manager. Engage with various internal stakeholders such as Partner Relations (PAR), Value Added Service (VAS), Legal, fleet, and network health teams. Facilitate and execute Monitoring and Enforcement Policies (MEP) and establish two-way feedback channels with OTR teams, DSPs, and WW/EU Product and Strategy teams. Work with Amazon’s safety and regional operations teams to maintain safe and compliant partner businesses, coaching owners on high-performing operations. Support new owners through onboarding and launch processes, guiding them in scaling operations, managing issues, and preparing for peak periods. Analyze customer metrics to identify improvement opportunities and coach owners on effective use of Amazon’s delivery tools. Identify workflow inefficiencies and implement network-level improvements, while addressing delivery station processes that negatively impact operations. Strengthen relationships with delivery partners, improve their satisfaction, and act as their advocate within Amazon, while also raising driver standards. Qualifications and Requirements Experience influencing internal and external stakeholders. 5+ years of team management experience. 7+ years of experience in account or relationship management, small business logistics, or retail/vendor/supplier management. Experience in transportation or supply chain. Disability Inclusion Afaq - Logistics Branch fosters an inclusive culture. Candidates with disabilities requiring workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including interview or onboarding support, should visit https://********************************************** for more information. If the country/region of application is not listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

d55a78662f66110d.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة خالد العبد الكريم عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في مدينة الرياض. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد ومراجعة السجلات المالية والتقارير المحاسبية. ضمان الامتثال للمعايير المحاسبية واللوائح المحلية. المساهمة في تحليل البيانات المالية وتقديم التوصيات. التعاون مع الأقسام الأخرى لضمان دقة المعلومات المالية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة شهادة بكالوريوس في المحاسبة. خبرة عملية لا تقل عن 4 سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. إقامة نظامية سارية المفعول داخل المملكة العربية السعودية. أن تكون المتقدمة مؤهلة للعمل عبر خدمة أجير، وفق الشروط والضوابط المعتمدة. بيئة العمل تلتزم شركة خالد العبد الكريم بتوفير بيئة عمل احترافية وداعمة في مقرها بالرياض. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في المكتب. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم للوظيفة ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة للانضمام إلى فريقنا في الرياض.

d58aab8d66da0ea6.description: About Masan Properties Masan Properties is a design-driven property developer based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The company focuses on creating refined and enduring living spaces, with a portfolio that includes both residential and hospitality properties. Masan emphasizes thoughtful design, long-term quality, and high standards of care, collaborating with architects and designers who prioritize proportion, high-quality materials, and attention to detail. The Role: Hotel Operations Manager Masan Properties is seeking a Hotel Operations Manager to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time, on-site position responsible for overseeing daily hotel operations to ensure a seamless guest experience across the property. The manager will contribute to maintaining Masan’s design-led hospitality standards. Key Responsibilities Oversee daily hotel operations to ensure a seamless guest experience. Manage front-of-house and back-of-house activities, including room operations, housekeeping coordination, and service standards. Supervise and support staff, set performance expectations, and ensure training and development align with Masan’s hospitality standards. Monitor occupancy and revenue metrics. Manage budgets and operational costs. Coordinate with maintenance teams and external vendors. Ensure compliance with safety, health, and quality guidelines. Address guest feedback and resolve service issues promptly. Collaborate with leadership to improve processes and enhance overall customer satisfaction. Required Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of prior experience in hotel management or hospitality operations. Strong operations management skills, including experience overseeing hotel or hospitality operations, coordinating departments, and managing budgets and resources. Demonstrated focus on customer satisfaction and service, with a track record of maintaining high service standards, handling guest feedback, and resolving issues effectively. Excellent communication skills, including clear verbal and written communication, the ability to interact with diverse guests and staff, and effective coordination with vendors and stakeholders. Proven training and team leadership capabilities, including coaching staff, organizing training programs, and supporting performance management and professional development. Knowledge of property management systems. Familiarity with safety and regulatory requirements. Strong problem-solving and organizational skills. A relevant bachelor’s degree in hospitality management, business administration, or a related field is preferred. Proficiency in English is required; Arabic language skills are an advantage. Work Environment This is an on-site position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Hotel Operations Manager will work within a team that values thoughtful design, long-term quality, and a high standard of care in all aspects of property management and guest services.

d5ead8e935b4af3c.description: About the Role Nice One is seeking an Area Manager to oversee the performance and daily operations of multiple locations within an assigned area. This full-time role involves supporting location leaders, implementing company standards, and monitoring financial and operational results across cities including Najran, Abha, Jeddah, and Medina. Role Purpose and Scope The Area Manager supports location leaders, implements company standards and business plans, and monitors financial and operational results. This position requires collaboration with cross-functional teams to enhance customer experience, improve team performance, and achieve business outcomes across the assigned area. Key Responsibilities Oversee daily operations across assigned locations, ensuring adherence to company procedures, service standards, and operational requirements. Monitor area and location performance against business goals, analyze trends, and implement plans to address gaps. Manage area budgets and operating costs, review financial reports, and identify opportunities to improve revenue and profitability. Lead, coach, and support location managers and their teams, setting clear expectations and fostering professional development. Collaborate with location leaders on staffing plans, coverage needs, hiring, and retention to ensure adequate resources. Promote consistent, high-quality customer service, review feedback, and coordinate follow-up actions. Ensure locations comply with company policies, safety requirements, regulations, and operational standards. Conduct regular site visits and performance reviews to assess operations and identify areas for improvement. Translate company priorities into actionable plans for the area and ensure consistent implementation across locations. Address operational, customer, and team concerns, escalating significant risks or issues as necessary. Prepare and review reports on sales, costs, staffing, service, and operational performance to support decision-making. Partner with departments such as Human Resources, Finance, Operations, and Marketing to achieve business objectives. Communicate company updates, expectations, and performance priorities to location teams, and relay area needs to leadership. Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in processes, efficiency, and service delivery across the area. Required Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, or a related field; equivalent education and relevant experience will be considered. Experience managing operations, teams, or business performance across multiple locations or departments. Demonstrated experience coaching managers or supervisors and supporting employee development. Experience monitoring budgets, sales, costs, operational metrics, or other business performance measures. Proficiency with business software, reporting tools, and spreadsheet applications, including Microsoft Excel. Ability to travel regularly among locations within the assigned area. Valid driver’s license and ability to meet the company’s travel requirements, if applicable. Work Environment and Location This full-time position requires regular travel within the assigned area, which includes the cities of Najran, Abha, Jeddah, and Medina. The Area Manager will work closely with various teams and departments to ensure operational excellence and business growth. Application Process Candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply for this role at Nice One.

d5e2cb800d884382.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صناع المراتب للصناعة عن أخصائي تجارة الكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على تحليل ومراجعة قوانين التجارة الإلكترونية وتنفيذ العمليات التجارية ذات الصلة، بالإضافة إلى تحديد فرص التطوير والتحسين في هذا المجال. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تحليل بيانات أبحاث السوق لتحديد سلوكيات المستهلكين وتفضيلاتهم وتطبيق أفضل الممارسات في هذا المجال. وضع استراتيجيات التجارة الإلكترونية وتنفيذها، وتحليل بيانات الأبحاث السوقية، وتقديم المشورة الإستراتيجية. تصميم وتشغيل حملات التسويق الخاصة بالتجارة الإلكترونية، وإدارة المنصات والأدوات المتاحة عبر شبكة الإنترنت. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتجارة الإلكترونية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة. عرض وتوضيح وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. التحليل المنطقي والسليم لحل المشكلات والقضايا المتعلقة بالتجارة الإلكترونية. تنفيذ العمليات التجارية والإجراءات المصاحبة باستخدام النماذج والوثائق اللازمة للتنفيذ وفقاً للسياسات واللوائح الموضوعة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التجارة الإلكترونية. فهم عميق لقوانين التجارة الإلكترونية وإجراءاتها. القدرة على تحليل بيانات السوق وتحديد سلوكيات المستهلكين. مهارات قوية في إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد التحديات والصعوبات التجارية. القدرة على وضع وتنفيذ استراتيجيات التجارة الإلكترونية. إدارة المنصات والأدوات الرقمية بفعالية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم المشورة الاستراتيجية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية، وتوفر فرصة للعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في مجال التجارة الإلكترونية في شركة صناع المراتب للصناعة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم لهذه الفرصة في مجال التجارة الإلكترونية.

d5e8e91a4b65553b.description: About the Role GE Vernova is seeking a Strategic Account Manager to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role reports directly to the GE Vernova Saudi Arabia Managing Director and is central to advancing the company's growth and strategic presence across the Kingdom. The position requires a minimum of 10 years of experience and focuses on developing and executing strategic initiatives that leverage GE Vernova’s comprehensive electrification portfolio. Role Context and Objectives The Strategic Account Manager will utilize business acumen and versatility to navigate Saudi Arabia’s evolving energy landscape and engage with key stakeholders. A primary objective is to strengthen and expand key customer relationships, ensuring alignment with client needs while driving sustainable business growth. This role also supports the Kingdom’s energy transformation and localization ambitions by integrating national priorities into account strategies. Key Responsibilities Serve as the primary point of contact for key strategic customers, leading business growth initiatives and ensuring alignment with GE Vernova's regional and global objectives. Develop and implement medium- to long-term account plans and strategies (3–5 years) guided by structured Strategic Account Development Plans. Integrate Saudi Arabia’s localization and local content requirements into account strategies to maximize in-Kingdom value creation. Identify and capture new business opportunities across GE Vernova’s Electrification portfolio, including Grid Systems Integration, Grid Automation & Software, Power Transmission, and Power Conversion & Storage. Build and maintain executive-level relationships with customers, government entities, and key stakeholders to support long-term partnership development. Collaborate with GE Vernova business units to deliver integrated solutions that address customer challenges and support the Kingdom’s Vision 2030 objectives. Lead a virtual, cross-border account team to identify and capitalize on opportunities, engaging with top management and board members. Identify and generate business opportunities by understanding customer needs in the context of Saudi Vision 2030, coordinating with internal stakeholders to deliver tailored grid solutions. Create value for the customer by utilizing GE Vernova's full capabilities, aiming for competitive differentiation, profitable growth, and increased share of wallet. Maintain account transparency and track progress through dedicated performance dashboards. Manage complex strategic projects, bringing together diverse stakeholders from across GE Vernova to shape strategic priorities within the Kingdom. Contribute to the enhancement of account management methods and tools, supporting the specific focus areas of the GE Vernova Saudi Arabia leadership team. Ensure customer satisfaction by proactively resolving execution and project challenges, growing relationships through project success, and leveraging successes for new opportunities. Required Qualifications A minimum of 10 years' experience in the Electrical field working with a Saudi Energy Company, with proven experience in strategic key account management as a recognized expert. Proven experience in the energy sector with a strong background in account management, strategy, business development, sales, or major project management. Demonstrable success in managing and significantly growing large, complex accounts within the energy or industrial sectors. Deep understanding of the Middle Eastern energy landscape, local regulatory frameworks, and large-scale TSO & DSO dynamics. Legal right to work in KSA without company sponsorship or time restriction. Desired Characteristics Exceptional leadership and teamwork skills, paired with a versatile and agile mindset. Strong conceptual problem-solving abilities, combining a strategic approach with a hands-on mentality to deliver tangible results. Excellent communicative and interpersonal skills, including executive-level communication. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified qualifications and are interested in contributing to GE Vernova's strategic growth in Saudi Arabia are encouraged to apply.

d52f8c154b31e866.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة البكار الدولية عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان، ووضع خطط العلاج، وإجراء المعالجات السنية المختلفة، بالإضافة إلى متابعة تركيبات الأسنان وجراحات الفم الصغرى. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحص الشامل لأسنان المرضى، وتحديد الصور الشعاعية اللازمة وتحليلها، وتشخيص حالات الفم والأسنان المرضية، ثم إعداد خطة العلاج والبرنامج الزمني الخاص بها. تجهيز وتطبيق الحشوات، ومعالجة القنوات اللبية للأسنان، وتنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية. تحديد احتياجات المريض من التعويضات السنية، وأخذ القياسات اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها، ومعالجة التهابات اللثة، وإجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى، ووصف العلاجات والأدوية المناسبة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال طب الأسنان. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بطب الأسنان وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال طب وصحة الأسنان. المؤهلات والخبرة شهادة جامعية في طب الأسنان. خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال طب الأسنان العام. القدرة على تشخيص وعلاج مجموعة واسعة من أمراض الفم والأسنان. مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع المرضى والزملاء. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل طبيب الأسنان ضمن فريق متخصص لتقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة للمرضى. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. المنطقة: المدينة المنورة. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة المهنية في شركة البكار الدولية.

d53847f7050412b8.description: About Baker Hughes Baker Hughes is an energy technology company providing solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. With a century of experience and operations in over 120 countries, the company focuses on innovative technologies and services that advance energy, making it safer, cleaner, and more efficient. The Role: Drilling Services Applications Engineer Baker Hughes is seeking a Drilling Services Applications Engineer for a full-time position in Dhahran, Eastern region. This role involves ensuring flawless execution of drilling services through active participation in pre-planning, job execution, and post-job analysis. The Applications Engineer will collaborate with Service Delivery Coordinators and other cross-functional resources to ensure all application aspects and constraints are thoroughly understood and addressed. d51a1e8e0d0f51ab.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سليمان محمد عجرم العنزي للمقاولات عن فني صيانة مبانٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة الجوف، وتحديداً في قرية العليا والقريات. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة خطط الصيانة الدورية للأبنية، وتحديد المواد والمعدات اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة، بالإضافة إلى كيل الأعمال المنجزة وإعداد المطالبات المالية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة تفاصيل خطة الصيانة الدورية لمختلف الأبنية، وتحديد العيوب الفنية، ومناقشة طرق معالجتها مع المهندس المختص. إعداد قوائم بالمواد اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة المختلفة، بالإضافة إلى تحديد الأدوات والمعدات والعمال المطلوبين لإنجاز العمل. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة، والتحقق من مطابقة الأعمال المنفذة للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. توضيح تفاصيل المخططات للمرؤوسين، ومتابعة دوام فرق العمل المختلفة، ورفع تقارير دورية بشأن الأعمال المنجزة. كيل الأعمال المنجزة، وحساب كمياتها وتدقيقها، وإعداد المطالبات المالية بالتنسيق مع محاسب الكميات، وتسليم الأعمال لجهة الإشراف. متطلبات الخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال صيانة المباني أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم جيد لخطط الصيانة الدورية والطارئة للمباني. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الفنية ومواصفات العمل. بيئة العمل سيعمل فني صيانة المباني في مشروع نظافة وصيانة وتشغيل المدينة السكنية بمنفذ الحديثة، ضمن فريق عمل متخصص يهدف إلى الحفاظ على جودة وكفاءة الأبنية والمرافق. يتطلب الدور التواجد في المواقع المحددة في قرية العليا والقريات بمنطقة الجوف. طبيعة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب الالتزام بجدول زمني محدد لضمان تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة بكفاءة وفعالية. الراتب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

d5e503d84f1dccc8.description: Job description STAGE - Assimilation de données de calculs éléments finis de pièces composites à matrice céramique F/H Stage 6 mois Etudiant Temps complet L'utilisation des matériaux composites dans l'aéronautique contribue à améliorer les performances des moteurs d'avions. Pour des hautes températures, les composites à matrice céramique (CMC) montrent d'excellentes propriétés thermomécaniques et thermiques qui garantissent leurs capacités de fonctionnement. Leur utilisation dans les zones chaudes des moteurs permettrait d'augmenter significativement leur température d'utilisation, et donc leur rendement, ce qui représente une alternative intéressante aux matériaux métalliques. C'est dans ce contexte industriel que Safran CERAMICS développe de nouveaux matériaux CMC ainsi que les pièces associées. Le stage a pour objectif de mettre en œuvre une Intelligence Artificielle (IA) capable d'apprendre à partir de données issues de simulations par éléments finis, portant sur des pièces en matériaux composites à matrice céramique. Vous devrez collecter et organiser un ensemble structuré de résultats de calculs (contraintes, déformations, modes de rupture…), puis développer un modèle d'IA (par exemple, machine learning ou deep learning) permettant de prédire rapidement le comportement mécanique de nouvelles pièces ou configurations. Le projet vise à optimiser les temps de calcul et à améliorer la fiabilité des prédictions structurales, apportant ainsi un gain significatif dans les phases de conception et de validation. Ce sujet permettra de croiser des compétences en simulation numérique, science des matériaux composites et intelligence artificielle. - Vous en formation mécanique, modélisation éléments finis, IA (machine learning pour la mécanique) avec des connaissances en Python Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

d5b0e1a84f03348c.description: We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Financial Controller to oversee the hotel’s financial and accounting operations. The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring financial accuracy, regulatory compliance, effective cost control, and sustainable profitability. The Financial Controller will partner closely with the General Manager, Executive Leadership Team, and Department Heads to provide strategic financial insights, strengthen internal controls, optimize cash flow, and support informed business decisions. Key Responsibilities Lead and oversee all financial accounting and reporting functions in accordance with applicable accounting standards, hotel policies, and regulatory requirements. Prepare and review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, management reports, forecasts, and financial analyses. Develop, coordinate, and monitor the hotel’s annual budget, financial forecasts, and business plans. Analyze financial and operational performance, identify variances, and provide actionable recommendations to management. Monitor cash flow, working capital, receivables, payables, and liquidity to maintain strong financial health. Establish and maintain effective internal controls, financial policies, and procedures to safeguard hotel assets and minimize financial risk. Oversee cost control and expense management, identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency and profitability. Provide financial guidance to department heads and support them in achieving budgetary and financial targets. Monitor key hotel performance indicators, including GOP, departmental profitability, payroll costs, food & beverage costs, and operating expenses. Coordinate with external auditors, tax advisors, banks, and relevant authorities as required. Ensure the accuracy and integrity of accounting records and financial data within the hotel’s PMS, accounting systems, and ERP platforms. Support senior management with financial modeling, investment analysis, business cases, and strategic decision-making. Lead, mentor, and develop the finance team to maintain high standards of performance, professionalism, and accountability. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in finance and accounting, preferably within the hotel or hospitality industry. Strong knowledge of hotel accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and internal controls. Solid understanding of applicable international accounting standards and financial practices. Proficiency in English, both written and spoken. Strong analytical, financial, leadership, and problem-solving skills. Hands-on experience with accounting systems, PMS, ERP platforms, and Microsoft Excel. Ability to work effectively with senior management and cross-functional hotel teams. Strong attention to detail, integrity, confidentiality, and a results-oriented approach.
